# The documentation site's generator and what it needs, at exact versions.
#
#   uvx --constraints .github/docs-constraints.txt zensical serve
#   uvx --constraints .github/docs-constraints.txt zensical build --strict
#
# Zensical is a tool that builds the site (docs/, zensical.toml). It is not a
# dependency of the package and is not in uv.lock, so `licenseal check` on
# this repository does not report it. It is pre-1.0: change the versions on
# purpose, from the root of the repository, where uv takes the cooldown of
# new releases from pyproject.toml (`exclude-newer`; uvx does not), with
#
#   echo "zensical==<version>" | uv pip compile - --universal --python-version 3.11 --no-header --no-annotate
#
# and look at the built site afterwards. The advisories hook checks the pins.
click==8.5.0
deepmerge==3.0.1
jinja2==3.1.6
markdown==3.11.2
markupsafe==3.0.4
pathspec==1.1.1
pygments==2.21.0
pymdown-extensions==12.3
pyyaml==6.0.3
tomli==2.5.0
zensical==0.0.71
